title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder with Glass Shelf, Wall Mount Solid Brass, Waverly Place Collection Allied Brass
short_title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder with Glass Shelf
description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a covered toilet paper holder featuring a convenient glass shelf and enduring solid brass construction. Designed for wall-mount installation, it helps save space while keeping essentials within easy reach—ideal for transitional bath accessories and coordinated suites.

Highlights:
- Covered design helps protect tissue from moisture and dust
- Glass shelf provides a handy spot to keep small items dry
- Crafted from solid brass for lasting performance
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, finished look
- Part of the Waverly Place Collection for matching Waverly Place, grooved bathroom hardware coordination

Specs:
- Collection: Waverly Place
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Overall size: 8.75 in L x 6 in W x 4.6 in H (6 in projection)
- Weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly: Not required
- Included: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including statement colors such as sea foam green, glokzin teal, fire engine red, mediterranean blue, and pink.
